list_accounts.title: List accounts
list_accounts.description: List the CallRail accounts the API key can access, with id, name, outbound_recording_enabled and hipaa_account. Call this first to find the account_id every other CallRail tool needs.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

hipaa_account.description: Only accounts that are (true) or are not (false) HIPAA accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: numeric_id.

output.description: Paginated envelope: page, per_page, total_pages, total_records and `accounts`.

get_account.title: Get an account
get_account.description: Retrieve one CallRail account by id (name, outbound recording and HIPAA flags). Use list_accounts to discover ids.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: numeric_id.

list_calls.title: List calls
list_calls.description: List calls in an account, newest first, with caller, tracking number, duration, answered/voicemail flags and recording link. Filter by company, tracker, date, direction, answer and lead status, tags or search; request extras such as transcription, tags, source or value through `fields`. For totals use summarize_calls; for one call use get_call.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

company_id.description: Only calls to tracking numbers belonging to this company.

tracker_id.description: Only calls to this tracker (tracking number).

tags.description: Only calls carrying this tag name.

search.description: Search term matched against business_phone_number, customer_name, customer_number, note, source and tracking_phone_number.

date_range.description: Standard date range (default `recent` = last 7 days incl. today). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given. Records older than 25 months are not retained.

start_date.description: Inclusive start, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-01 or 2024-10-01T10:00.

end_date.description: Inclusive end, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-17.

time_zone.description: Time zone used to interpret dates, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the API user's time zone.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

relative_pagination.description: Use relative pagination (recommended for large result sets): the response carries next_page/has_next_page instead of page counts.

offset.description: With relative_pagination, jump to a page (0-based: offset=9 is the 10th page).

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: agent_email, call_disposition, call_highlights, call_summary, call_type, campaign, company_id, company_name, company_time_zone, created_at, custom, device_type, fbclid, first_call, formatted_call_type, formatted_customer_location, formatted_business_phone_number, formatted_customer_name, formatted_customer_phone_number, formatted_duration, formatted_tracking_phone_number, formatted_tracking_source, formatted_value, ga, gclid, good_lead_call_id, good_lead_call_time, keypad_entries, keywords, keywords_spotted, landing_page_url, last_requested_url, lead_status, medium, milestones, msclkid, note, person_id, prior_calls, referrer_domain, referring_url, sentiment, session_uuid, source, source_name, speaker_percent, tags, timeline_url, total_calls, tracker_id, transcription, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_medium, utm_source, utm_term, value, voice_assist_message, waveforms, zip_code, lead_score, lead_explanation.

output.description: Paginated envelope with `calls` (and page counts, or next_page/has_next_page with relative pagination).

get_call.title: Get a call
get_call.description: Retrieve one call by id with its caller, tracking number, timing, recording and answered state. Add `fields` for transcription, conversational_transcript, call_summary, tags, source, value, lead_status and more.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: agent_email, call_disposition, call_highlights, call_summary, call_type, campaign, company_id, company_name, company_time_zone, conversational_transcript, integration_data, created_at, custom, device_type, fbclid, first_call, formatted_call_type, formatted_customer_location, formatted_business_phone_number, formatted_customer_name, formatted_customer_phone_number, formatted_duration, formatted_tracking_phone_number, formatted_tracking_source, formatted_value, ga, gclid, good_lead_call_id, good_lead_call_time, keypad_entries, keywords, keywords_spotted, landing_page_url, last_requested_url, lead_status, medium, milestones, msclkid, note, person_id, prior_calls, referrer_domain, referring_url, sentiment, session_uuid, source, source_name, speaker_percent, tags, timeline_url, total_calls, tracker_id, transcription, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_medium, utm_source, utm_term, value, voice_assist_message, waveforms, zip_code, lead_score, lead_explanation.

get_call_transcript.title: Get a call's transcript
get_call_transcript.description: Retrieve a call's transcription, speaker-separated conversational_transcript, AI call_summary and call_highlights in one request (the Retrieving a Single Call endpoint with those fields selected). Transcript fields are null unless the account has Premium Conversation Intelligence and recording is enabled.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

output.description: The call object including transcription, conversational_transcript (array of speaker/phrase/start), call_summary, call_highlights and sentiment.

create_outbound_call.title: Place an outbound call
create_outbound_call.description: Place an outbound call: CallRail first rings business_phone_number, then dials the customer from caller_id (a tracking number or verified outbound caller ID). US/Canada 10-digit numbers only. This dials real phones immediately.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

caller_id.description: Tracking number or verified external number shown to the customer, as a 10-digit US/Canada number, e.g. 4045551234.

customer_phone_number.description: Customer's 10-digit US/Canada number to dial once the business answers.

business_phone_number.description: Business 10-digit US/Canada number that is rung first.

outbound_greeting_recording_url.description: URL of an audio file played to the customer on answer.

outbound_greeting_text.description: Text read to the customer on answer.

agent_id.description: User ID of the agent to assign to the call.

update_call.title: Update a call
update_call.description: Update a call's tags, note, monetary value, lead status or customer name, or mark it as spam. Omitted fields are unchanged; tags replace the existing set unless append_tags is true.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

tags.description: Tag names to set on the call; unknown tags are created in the company.

append_tags.description: Add `tags` to the existing tags instead of replacing them.

customer_name.description: Name of the lead associated with the call.

spam.description: true marks the call as spam (removes it from logs, reports and billing in the current cycle). Cannot be undone via the API.

summarize_calls.title: Summarize call data
summarize_calls.description: Aggregate call metrics (total, missed, answered, first-time callers, average duration, leads) over a date range, optionally grouped by source, keywords, campaign, referrer, landing page or company. Use get_call_timeseries for per-interval buckets.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated metrics: total_calls, missed_calls, answered_calls, first_time_callers, average_duration, formatted_average_duration, leads. Default total_calls.

min_duration.description: Only calls longer than this many seconds.

max_duration.description: Only calls shorter than this many seconds.

tags.description: Only calls with these tags, comma-separated (e.g. A,B).

tracker_id.description: Only calls made to this tracker id (sent as tracker_ids[]).

first_time_callers.description: true for only first-time callers, false for only repeat callers.

agent.description: Only calls to this agent (user ID).

search.description: Search term matched against the call source.

date_range.description: Standard date range (default `recent` = last 7 days incl. today). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given. Records older than 25 months are not retained.

start_date.description: Inclusive start, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-01 or 2024-10-01T10:00.

end_date.description: Inclusive end, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-17.

time_zone.description: Time zone used to interpret dates, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the API user's time zone.

output.description: Summary object with the date range, time zone and the requested totals (or grouped totals).

get_call_timeseries.title: Call data time series
get_call_timeseries.description: Return call metrics bucketed by hour, day, week, month or year over a date range, for charts and trend analysis. Use summarize_calls for a single total.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated metrics: total_calls, missed_calls, answered_calls, first_time_callers, formatted_average_duration, leads. Default total_calls.

min_duration.description: Only calls longer than this many seconds.

max_duration.description: Only calls shorter than this many seconds.

tags.description: Only calls with these tags, comma-separated (e.g. A,B).

tracker_id.description: Only calls made to this tracker id (sent as tracker_ids[]).

first_time_callers.description: true for only first-time callers, false for only repeat callers.

agent.description: Only calls to this agent (user ID).

search.description: Search term matched against the call source.

date_range.description: Standard date range (default `recent` = last 7 days incl. today). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given. Records older than 25 months are not retained.

start_date.description: Inclusive start, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-01 or 2024-10-01T10:00.

end_date.description: Inclusive end, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-17.

time_zone.description: Time zone used to interpret dates, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the API user's time zone.

output.description: Time series object with one data point per interval.

get_call_recording.title: Get a call recording
get_call_recording.description: Get the recording URL for a call (a temporary link to the audio file). HIPAA accounts get a recording player URL instead.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

output.description: Object with `url` pointing at the recording audio.

list_call_page_views.description: List the website pages the caller viewed in the session that led to a call (url, timestamp), for attribution analysis.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

time_zone.description: Time zone for timestamps, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.

list_tags.title: List tags
list_tags.description: List tags in an account (id, name, color, tag_level, status, company). Filter by company, status or level.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

company_id.description: Only tags belonging to this company.

tag_level.description: Only tags at this level. Cannot combine tag_level=account with company_id.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

create_tag.title: Create a tag
create_tag.description: Create a tag for classifying calls, texts and forms. Company-level by default (company_id required); tag_level=account creates an account-wide tag (administrators only).

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

company_id.description: Company the tag belongs to; required unless tag_level is account.

color.description: Color name from CallRail's tag palette.

tag_level.description: account for an account-wide tag; omit for a company tag.

update_tag.title: Update a tag
update_tag.description: Rename, recolor or disable a tag. Renaming changes it everywhere it is applied; disabling stops new use but keeps existing assignments.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

color.description: Color name from CallRail's tag palette.

disabled.description: true disables the tag, false re-enables it.

delete_tag.title: Delete a tag
delete_tag.description: Permanently remove a tag and its assignments from all calls, texts and forms. Use update_tag with disabled=true to retire it instead.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

update_company.title: Update a company
update_company.description: Update a company's name, time zone, CallScore/CallScribe, DNI swap overrides, cookie duration or external form capture. Omitted fields are unchanged.

swap_ppc_override.description: Override the original source when a visitor arrives via PPC.

external_form_capture.description: Turn external form capture on or off.

bulk_update_companies.description: Turn external form capture on or off for several companies at once (or every company with company_ids=["all"]).

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

external_form_capture.description: Turn external form capture on or off.

disable_company.title: Disable a company
disable_company.description: Disable a company, which also disables its tracking numbers and stops tracking. Tracking numbers released this way may be lost.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

create_form_submission.description: Record a form submission in CallRail for attribution. Provide referrer, referring_url and landing_page_url, or a session_id instead of those three.

form_data.description: Map of form field names to submitted values.

landing_page_url.description: Page the visitor landed on. Required unless session_id is given.

summarize_forms.title: Summarize form data

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

create_outbound_caller_id.title: Create an outbound caller ID
create_outbound_caller_id.description: Register an external phone number as an outbound caller ID; CallRail calls the number to verify it.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

output.description: The created caller ID with verification details.

delete_outbound_caller_id.title: Delete an outbound caller ID
delete_outbound_caller_id.description: Delete an outbound caller ID so it can no longer be used for outbound calls.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

list_sms_threads.title: List SMS threads
list_sms_threads.description: List SMS threads (per customer/tracking-number conversations with lead details). Filter by company and date, or search by customer phone, name or tag.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

search.description: Search by customer phone number, customer name or tag name.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include.

get_sms_thread.title: Get an SMS thread
get_sms_thread.description: Retrieve one SMS thread with its messages (paginated, max 100 per page), optionally including error details for failed messages.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

with_msg_errors.description: Include error details for failed messages.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include.

update_sms_thread.title: Update an SMS thread
update_sms_thread.description: Update an SMS thread's notes, value, tags or lead qualification. Tags replace existing ones unless append_tags is true.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

list_text_conversations.title: List text conversations
list_text_conversations.description: List text message conversations with their recent messages. Filter by company and date, or search by customer phone or name. See list_sms_threads for thread-level lead data.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

date_range.description: Standard date range (default `recent` = last 7 days incl. today). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given. Records older than 25 months are not retained.

start_date.description: Inclusive start, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-01 or 2024-10-01T10:00.

end_date.description: Inclusive end, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2024-10-17.

time_zone.description: Time zone used to interpret dates, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the API user's time zone.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: lead_status, source.

get_text_conversation.title: Get a text conversation
get_text_conversation.description: Retrieve one text conversation with all its messages (direction, content, timestamps, media URLs).

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: lead_status, source.

send_text_message.title: Send a text message
send_text_message.description: Send an SMS (or MMS with media_url) to a customer from a company's tracking number. US/Canada 10-digit numbers; content max 140 characters. Sends immediately.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number to send from; optional when a conversation with this customer already exists.

media_url.description: Public URL of a JPEG, PNG or GIF (max 5MB) to send as MMS.

output.description: The conversation including the sent message.

list_message_flows.title: List message flows
list_message_flows.description: List message flows (automated SMS auto-replies and advanced flows) with their steps.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

company_id.description: Only flows owned by this company.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

get_message_flow.title: Get a message flow
get_message_flow.description: Retrieve one message flow with its initial step and full step graph.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

create_message_flow.title: Create a message flow
create_message_flow.description: Create an automated text message flow (auto-reply, schedules, tagging, forwarding) for a company; attach it to trackers via message_flow.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

initial_step_id.description: ID of the first step (your own id such as response-01 is replaced on create).

steps.description: Object keyed by step id. Each step has id, type (schedule, sms_response, no_response, tag, forward_message), initial_step and next_step_id, plus type fields: schedule.branches[].times[] {day, start_time, end_time}; sms_response {message, first_text}; tag {tag_ids}; forward_message {destination_number}.

update_message_flow.title: Update a message flow
update_message_flow.description: Rename a message flow or replace its steps and initial step.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

steps.description: Object keyed by step id. Each step has id, type (schedule, sms_response, no_response, tag, forward_message), initial_step and next_step_id, plus type fields: schedule.branches[].times[] {day, start_time, end_time}; sms_response {message, first_text}; tag {tag_ids}; forward_message {destination_number}.

delete_message_flow.title: Delete a message flow
delete_message_flow.description: Delete a message flow; trackers using it stop sending those automated texts.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

list_trackers.title: List trackers
list_trackers.description: List trackers (session/DNI pools and source tracking numbers) with numbers, call flow, source and status. Filter by company, type or status, or search by name.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: campaign_name, swap_targets.

get_tracker.title: Get a tracker
get_tracker.description: Retrieve one tracker with its tracking numbers, call flow, message flow, source and whisper settings.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

fields.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include in each record. Available: campaign_name, swap_targets.

create_session_tracker.title: Create a session tracker
create_session_tracker.description: Create a session (dynamic number insertion) tracker: provisions a pool of 4-50 numbers swapped per website visitor. This rents phone numbers billed to the account.
create_session_tracker.notes: CallRail also accepts the bare string "all" as a session tracker's source (track every visitor); this tool only sends an object, so set that in the CallRail app or via a raw request.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

call_flow.description: Call flow. Basic: {"type":"basic","destination_number":"+15558675309","recording_enabled":true,"greeting_text":null,"greeting_recording_url":null}; or an existing advanced flow {"type":"advanced","uuid":"..."}.

pool_size.description: Number of phone numbers in the pool (4-50).

pool_numbers.description: Number constraints: {area_code, local, toll_free}, e.g. {"local":"+14045558769"} or {"toll_free":true}.

source.description: Which visitors see the pool: keys google/bing/yahoo (arrays of paid, organic), landing and referrer (arrays of match strings), type ("direct" to include direct visitors) and inverted (bool), e.g. {"google":["paid"],"landing":["facebook_landing"]}.

whisper_message.description: Message played to the call recipient before connecting; [source] whispers the source.

swap_targets.description: Website phone numbers to replace with the tracking number (defaults to the destination number).

sms_enabled.description: Allow texting on the tracking numbers (US/Canada local numbers only).

message_flow.description: Message flow for inbound texts (requires sms_enabled), e.g. {"type":"advanced","id":"MFL..."} or an auto-reply definition.

output.description: The created tracker with its tracking numbers.

create_source_tracker.title: Create a source tracker
create_source_tracker.description: Create a source tracker: one tracking number for a marketing source (offline, search, referrer, landing URL/params, Google My Business...). Rents a phone number billed to the account.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

call_flow.description: Call flow. Basic: {"type":"basic","destination_number":"+15558675309","recording_enabled":true,"greeting_text":null,"greeting_recording_url":null}; or an existing advanced flow {"type":"advanced","uuid":"..."}.

source.description: Source definition, e.g. {"type":"offline"}, {"type":"search","search_engine":"google","search_type":"paid"} (see Source Tracker Call Sources).

whisper_message.description: Message played to the call recipient before connecting; [source] whispers the source.

swap_targets.description: Website phone numbers to replace with the tracking number (defaults to the destination number).

sms_enabled.description: Allow texting on the tracking numbers (US/Canada local numbers only).

message_flow.description: Message flow for inbound texts (requires sms_enabled), e.g. {"type":"advanced","id":"MFL..."} or an auto-reply definition.

output.description: The created tracker with its tracking number.

update_tracker.title: Update a tracker
update_tracker.description: Update a session or source tracker: name, whisper, swap targets, SMS, call/message flow, source, campaign name (source only), grow a session pool (pool_size can only increase), or replace a spammed tracking number.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

call_flow.description: Call flow. Basic: {"type":"basic","destination_number":"+15558675309","recording_enabled":true,"greeting_text":null,"greeting_recording_url":null}; or an existing advanced flow {"type":"advanced","uuid":"..."}.

pool_size.description: Session trackers only: new pool size (can only increase).

replace_tracking_number.description: E.164 tracking number to swap for a fresh one in the same area code (for spam/wrong-number issues).

whisper_message.description: Message played to the call recipient before connecting; [source] whispers the source.

swap_targets.description: Website phone numbers to replace with the tracking number (defaults to the destination number).

sms_enabled.description: Allow texting on the tracking numbers (US/Canada local numbers only).

message_flow.description: Message flow for inbound texts (requires sms_enabled), e.g. {"type":"advanced","id":"MFL..."} or an auto-reply definition.

disable_tracker.title: Disable a tracker
disable_tracker.description: Disable a tracker and release its tracking numbers; the numbers stop routing calls and may not be recoverable.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

list_users.description: List users in an account (id, name, email, role, companies). Filter by company or search by first name, last name or email.

company_id.description: Only users with access to this company.

search.description: Search by first_name, last_name or email.

page.description: Page number to return; the first page is 1.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

email.description: New email (own user only; needs current_password).

current_password.description: The user's current password, required to change email.

companies.description: Full list of company IDs the user should access.

delete_user.description: Remove a user from the account; they lose access immediately.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to include.

get_lead_timeline.description: Retrieve a lead and its chronological timeline of calls, texts, form submissions and other events.

account_id.description: CallRail account ID (e.g. ACC8154748ae6bd4e278a7cddd38a662f4f, or the numeric id). Get it from list_accounts.

frequency.description: One or more of daily, weekly, monthly.

config.description: Which sections to include: {"summary_statistics":bool, "top_sources":bool, "top_keywords":bool, "call_log":bool} (at least one key).

filters.description: Filters, e.g. {"lead_status": "Lead"} (Lead, Not a Lead, Not Scored or All).

config.description: Which sections to include: {"summary_statistics":bool, "top_sources":bool, "top_keywords":bool, "call_log":bool} (at least one key).

frequency.description: Frequencies to keep: daily, weekly, monthly.

filters.description: Filters, e.g. {"lead_status": "Lead"} (Lead, Not a Lead, Not Scored or All).
